item.description: The next_token function incorrectly handles incomplete tokens at the end of strings. Currently, it returns None for token type when encountering incomplete tokens, but tests expect proper handling of truncated tokens like integers and names.
item.contract: When the next_token function encounters an incomplete token at the end of a string, it should return the appropriate token type ('INTEGER', 'REAL', 'NAME', etc.) instead of None. The function should properly detect and return the token type based on the content prefix.

item.description: The replace_ref function does not correctly handle reference tokens in arrays and dictionaries. It only processes references when they appear as consecutive tokens (number 0 R) but doesn't properly process references within arrays or when they are not in the expected format.
item.contract: The replace_ref function should properly convert reference tokens (like '6 0 R') into complex number representations (6j) regardless of their position in arrays or dictionaries. It should process all valid reference patterns correctly.

item.description: The parse_obj function does not correctly handle comments and whitespace around tokens, causing failures in tests involving comments. The function skips comments but doesn't properly handle all whitespace scenarios and comment placements.
item.contract: The parse_obj function should correctly parse objects while properly handling comments and whitespace in all positions. It should skip comments and whitespace appropriately, allowing for robust parsing of PDF objects with comments.

item.description: The build_index_from_chrono function fails with IndexError when dealing with empty lists or missing keys in the chrono data structure. This happens when processing PDF files that have malformed or incomplete cross-reference data.
item.contract: The build_index_from_chrono function should gracefully handle empty chrono lists and missing keys in the data structure without raising IndexError exceptions. It should return appropriate default values or empty structures when data is missing.

item.description: The decode_stream function lacks proper handling for different stream filters and predictors. It only supports FlateDecode but needs to support various other stream filters and predictor algorithms for complete PDF stream decoding.
item.contract: The decode_stream function should properly handle various stream filters and predictor algorithms as specified in the PDF specification. It should support different compression methods and predictor types commonly used in PDF streams.
item.acceptance: Stream-related tests that are currently failing due to incomplete stream decoding
